notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes: [h2]Hello travelers to Yariv, [/h2][p][/p][p]As we work on the main game, we are implementing numerous improvements and moving closer to our final vision. [/p][p]However, we don't want to keep it from you, so we've decided to update the demo and give you a small glimpse of our work behind the scenes. [/p][p][/p][h3]The new demo contains: [/h3][p][b]New Content --------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Reworked texture for almost every object in the game![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New and more polished tutorial (Black and White Forest)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New tree models in the forest area [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements[/b] [b]------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improvements to Mask Altar UI [/p][/*][*][p]Better scrolling in menus with the mouse scroll [/p][/*][*][p]Better display of shield's passive defence in inventory [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes -------------------------------------------------------------------[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Broken Sword received a damage and reach buff [/p][/*][*][p]Barrels' durability changed: 150HP --> 70HP [/p][/*][*][p]Burn and poison deal more damage to enemies [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Glitches -------------------------------------------------------------------[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Brawler ring HP decrease bug fixed [/p][/*][*][p]More minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Play the new demo for yourself and let us know what you think - either as a Steam review or in our active Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa"]https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I wish you great adventures in Yariv! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/2f3fbb78ba80f3c46c4a3d0049622a8236b216f9.jpg"][/img][/p]
